variants.title: Nebelschlucht
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished background image for Voidfleet, a science-fiction tactical spaceship card game.
Create ONE full-bleed landscape image, 2048 x 1152 pixels, 16:9. Environment artwork only.
Style: polished clean toon science-fiction environment, large deliberate graphic shapes, crisp silhouettes, restrained 3-tone cel shading, subtle luminous atmospheric depth, elegant mature animated-film art direction. Deep ink navy #171d2b and blue-black base. Not photorealism, not noisy painterly texture, not a flat vector star pattern.
Composition: genuine expansive three-dimensional space through occlusion, strongly varied scale, perspective, distinct near/middle/far layers. Near objects darker and crisper, distant objects smaller and hazier. Asymmetrical environmental forms concentrated toward outer thirds and upper perimeter. The central roughly 55% and lower center remain darker, subdued and spacious to keep an overlaid tactical board readable, but still contain subtle atmospheric depth rather than a blank rectangle. Avoid an obvious rectangular hole or symmetric tunnel framing. Edge elements must tolerate a 6% crop.
Light: controlled rim light and selective colored atmospheric glow; mostly dark values with restrained accents, no broad white highlights.
Constraints: no spaceships, characters, UI, cards, grids, labels, lettering, logos, watermark or decorative border. No collage, only one complete background.
Scene/backdrop: A vast canyon of interstellar nebula clouds: chunky near-black indigo dust banks overlap at the outer edges, broad teal gas formations in the mid-distance arc away in depth, a tiny scattered blue star cluster glows far beyond. One oblique winding opening into deep space, sculptural cloud masses with clean cel-shaded contours. Teal and muted cobalt rim light; sense of enormous distance.
